definitions.observed_cell: A (issuer_id, sampling_stratum, era, representation_class, length_category) combination that occurs on at least one profiled physical page of the frozen corpus metadata.
definitions.zero_availability_cell: A combination in the Cartesian product of the declared category levels that contains zero physical pages; it is never called observed and is never filled.

selection_rule.rank_function: SHA-256 over UTF-8(sampling_seed) NUL UTF-8(document_id) NUL ASCII(decimal page_number)
selection_rule.selection: smallest ordering key within each observed coverage cell

frozen_rationale.arpipe/models.py: glyphs drawn as vector paths -> OCR
frozen_rationale.arpipe/triage.py: many tiny fill-paths + no text => vector text
